coverage: Fresh scene generation, repeatable attached-bottle and free-grasp resets, and detection of deliberate arm contact.
Individual mapping, direction, tracking, and return for all nine servos with contacts disabled.
Free-bottle retention during upright hold and lift with simplified pads, followed by release.
Upright water hold, capture, miss, overflow, volume conservation, and static load compensation.

open_validation: Verify upright free-bottle retention with the imported finger geometry and no workspace support before testing lift and slow tilt. Measure the physical grip force and finger-to-bottle friction, then compare with simulation.
Extend contact coverage to include free-bottle workspace contact and relevant robot self-contact.
Compare simulated discharge, shutoff, and spill against measured water pours.
Compare simulated actuator tracking, geometry, and sensor observations with measurements on the physical setup.

no_pad_grasp_trial.setup: Temporary simulation with added grip pads removed. Bottle held upright at reset with 100 mL water and 215 g total modeled mass.
no_pad_grasp_trial.workspace_enabled: At sliding friction 0.9, the bottle slipped about 12 mm relative to the gripper and contacted the cylinder.
no_pad_grasp_trial.interpretation: The imported fingers lost the upright grasp at all three tested friction values. The friction values are provisional and the result still needs hardware validation.
